title: Revisiting Episode 8: Thinking on AI, the Future of Work, and the Commoditization of High(er) Skilled Labor
summary: A re-air of a 2022 conversation between Kahran and Divya about how DALL-E, GPT-3, Stable Diffusion and Mechanical-Turk-style platforms would chunk previously high-skilled work into pieces anyone could do. They use Wikipedia, Uber, dive computers and SEO copy as case studies for the same wave and try to predict where the commoditization goes next.

intents.display: to hear an early take on how ai would commoditize skilled work
